# umpyre

> Code analysis and quality metrics tracking system for CI/CD


## Pages

- [umpyre](index.html.md): Code analysis and quality metrics tracking system for CI/CD pipelines.
- [API reference](api.html.md): | &#96;umpyre&#96;   | Umpyre - Code analysis and quality metrics tracking.   |

- [umpyre.collectors.base](_autosummary/umpyre.collectors.base.html.md): Base collector class with Mapping interface.
- [umpyre.collectors.coverage_collector](_autosummary/umpyre.collectors.coverage_collector.html.md): Collector for test coverage metrics.
- [umpyre.collectors.umpyre_collector](_autosummary/umpyre.collectors.umpyre_collector.html.md): Collector using AST-based code analysis (safe, no code execution).
- [umpyre.collectors.wily_collector](_autosummary/umpyre.collectors.wily_collector.html.md): Collector for complexity metrics using wily.
- [umpyre.collectors.workflow_status](_autosummary/umpyre.collectors.workflow_status.html.md): Collector for GitHub workflow status using GitHub API.
- [umpyre.config](_autosummary/umpyre.config.html.md): Configuration loading and validation for umpyre.
- [umpyre.python_code_stats](_autosummary/umpyre.python_code_stats.html.md): Get stats about packages. Your own, or other’s.
- [umpyre.schema](_autosummary/umpyre.schema.html.md): Versioned schema for metrics storage and migration support.
- [umpyre.storage](_autosummary/umpyre.storage.html.md): Storage operations for metrics.
- [umpyre.storage.formats](_autosummary/umpyre.storage.formats.html.md): JSON and CSV serialization for metrics.
- [umpyre.storage.git_branch](_autosummary/umpyre.storage.git_branch.html.md): Git branch-based storage operations.
- [umpyre.storage.query_utils](_autosummary/umpyre.storage.query_utils.html.md): Helper utilities for working with umpyre metrics storage.
